### The University of Jordan
#### الجامعة الأردنية

---

| Course No. | Course Title                                     | Number of Credit Hours |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------|------------------------|
| 0401211     | Exegesis                                         | 3                      |
| **Prerequisite course**: 0401111                                                                                   |                        |
| This course aims to give the student an idea about the principles of exegesis concerning the Qur'an in the principles of belief and their effect on the establishment of society. The exegesis of Sections: 29 and 30 is a requirement of the course, in addition to the meanings of certain vocabularies of the second half of the Qur'an. |

| Course No. | Course Title                                     | Number of Credit Hours |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------|------------------------|
| 0401222     | Analytic Hadith                                  | 3                      |
| **Prerequisite course**: 0401121                                                                                   |                        |
| This course involves the analytical study of selected hadiths, focusing on their hadith-related issues in terms of chain of transmission and content. It includes the study of selected hadiths from Sahih Al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, and other sources, covering topics such as faith, jihad, governance, clothing, adornment, and characteristics of hypocrites. The course also requires students to read selected chapters from the mentioned books independently. |

| Course No. | Course Title                                     | Number of Credit Hours |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------|------------------------|
| 0441234     | The Skills of Giving Ceremonies, Preaching, and Media Communications | 3                      |
| **Prerequisite course**: 2301214                                                                                   |                        |
| This course provides students with the necessary skills and competencies that qualify them to join the job market in the field of delivering pulpit sermons, preaching, and counseling lessons, and trains them on that practically. It also acquaints the student with the principles of preparing an effective sermon, the arts of delivering it, and the basics of dealing with the public through media communication means, public lessons, and media communication sites. It also addresses the obstacles that the preacher and teacher may face in communicating with the public and teaches the skill of constructive, purposeful criticism. It includes the origins of moderate discourse and how to present moderate discourse through media communication and its various platforms in a way that reflects the tolerance of Islam, its human values, and its mercy to the worlds. |

| Course No. | Course Title                                     | Number of Credit Hours |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------|------------------------|
| 0431223     | Prophetic Guidance in Ethics, Manners, and Devotion | 3                     |
| **Prerequisite course**: None                                                                                   |                        |
| This course includes the study of twenty hadiths from Sahih Al-Bukhari in the book of "Al-Riqaq" (Heart-Softeners) and the study of selected hadiths from Sahih Muslim from the following books: etiquettes, expressions of etiquette, poetry, piety, kinship and manners, asceticism. It also addresses Islamic ethics. |

--- 

This document consists of outlined courses offered at the University of Jordan, focusing on various aspects of Islamic studies. Each course description includes its prerequisite courses and highlights its objectives and content.
